mockup_note: No screen. This is the agreement TERM only — the model the four surfaces will agree on. The screens that ask for it are the next piece.
notes: Commercial usage becomes a negotiable optional term on the agreement, settled before any campaign exists.
the_design: TWO RIGHTS, TWO PLACES. Showing her content on the brand and INFLX own social accounts is included by default and stated in the contract — negotiated by nobody, paid for by nobody. COMMERCIAL use is a different right, worth money, settled in the AGREEMENT before a campaign exists, while she can still say no or say yes for a price. Putting it in the contract would mean asking at the moment she is trying to start work.
kept_simple: His words: "dont make it complex." One flag and one number — { commercial: true, extra: 8000 }. Absent means social-only. commercial:false is how she refuses.
all_three_aims: Unlike deliverables, which only exist where a fee does. A commission creator content is as reusable as a paid one.

verification.my_fixture_was_wrong_three_times: The first draft omitted mode (required on every collaboration), then used a posting window, then used post_by AND a window. Each failure pointed at the fixture, not the model — a collaboration has ONE date and the window belongs to the set. Recorded because three wrong fixtures in a row is a sign I was guessing at a model I had not read closely enough.
verification.runner_gained_each: test.each was missing from the no-database runner. Added to the runner rather than the test being rewritten around it — a runner that quietly lacks what tests use pushes people towards weaker tests.
verification.regression: stage4-parcel 25/25, offers-parity 12/12, coupon 11/11. Mobile 44 suites / 507 tests.

not_built_yet: NO SCREEN ASKS FOR IT. A brand cannot yet state commercial usage from the app and she cannot yet see or counter it. Until the surfaces land this changes nothing a user can see.
